title: Burgers with degenerate critical dissipation
plain: Critical half-Laplacian dissipation keeps Burgers smooth. Let that dissipation switch off at one point of the circle. Do shocks form there?
math: Let $a(x)=1-\cos x$ and consider $u_t+uu_x+\Lambda^{1/2}\big(a\,\Lambda^{1/2}u\big)=0$ on $\mathbb T$, $\Lambda=(-\partial_x^2)^{1/2}$. Decide whether every $u_0\in C^\infty(\mathbb T)$ yields a global smooth solution.
